about_the_game:
Add wishlist!

Welcome to Terraspace! This is an adventure simulator, where you will build equipment that will allow you to extract the necessary resources: food, water, electricity and other supplies. You will have to collect resources for further survival in order to provide your team with everything necessary for survival in space.

Your main goal is to collect resources and not destroy the astronauts. Build new technologies for life, increase the settlement.

The game "Terraspace" offers you a unique experience of planet settlement and terraforming — creating conditions for life on unsuitable planets. This will require you to build the necessary structures to populate the planet.

Features of the game "Terraspace":

* Addictive and addictive gameplay.

* Beautiful graphics and atmospheric soundtrack.

Attention!

There are some constructions missing in this version of the game. There is also no save, so you will have to learn the game in one save.
